New schematic radii 35/10/20 mm and centre separations 65/36 mm allow the finite umbra lines to remain at least 12.7 mm long. Both shadow types are freshly constructed from the appropriate common tangents; the umbra stops at the near Earth surface, and the penumbra extends outside Earth. A small near-side totality patch remains, not whole-Earth darkness.
